info.brief: Provides functions for generating Simplex noise.
info.description: Provides functions for generating Simplex noise.

elements.name: simplex.seed
elements.description: Sets the seed for the noise generator.

elements.name: simplex.noise2
elements.description: Computes 2D Simplex noise, optionally with fractal parameters.

parameters.name: octaves
parameters.doc: Number of noise layers (must be > 0). Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: persistence
parameters.doc: Amplitude decrease per octave. Defaults to 0.5.

parameters.name: lacunarity
parameters.doc: Frequency increase per octave. Defaults to 2.0.

returnvalues.name: noise_value
returnvalues.doc: The calculated noise value. Output range is [0, 1].
